W4 after E009. Measured: E005 (SGD+EMA, 9ep) 0.7583 @9.10s. E006 (Muon, bs2000) 0.7649 @9.45s. E007 (Muon+EMA+resize 24/28/32, 9ep) 0.7590 @7.33s. E008 (8.5ep) 0.7572 @6.98s (tip). E009 (LR to 0) 0.7564 @6.99s, discarded.

Beliefs:
1. Time is mostly compute-bound, scaling with pixels x epochs. Resizing saved about 2s. One epoch costs about 0.7s at the E007 schedule. Fixed cost (prepare, whitening, upload, Muon/EMA launches, first-step effects) is about 0.5-1s. That fixed cost caps what any single trick can gain.
2. The real gains were EMA (+1pp), Muon (+0.6pp) and resizing (time -20%, accuracy -0.6pp). The half-epoch cut cost about 0.18pp. E009 showed LR-to-0 does not add to EMA (-0.08pp, noise). This confirms small schedule tweaks are null. I mis-predicted E009's direction by about 0.4pp, so my model of partly redundant gains was over-optimistic.
3. Noise. Compiled runs are near-deterministic per seed, but any recipe change reshuffles the trajectory. The 3-seed-mean accuracy noise from such changes is about 0.15-0.25pp (1 sigma), and time noise is about 1-2% (0.1s). The 40-seed mean is probably 0.1-0.3pp below the 3-seed mean. At 0.757 against the 0.753 bar, there is under 0.5pp of margin to spend.
4. Regression: the tip is already the best of several draws, so it is probably a mild lucky draw. A new variant should be expected to land about 0.1pp lower from selection alone.
5. Further time cuts cost accuracy. A more aggressive resize schedule (20 px phase) probably costs 0.4-0.8pp for about 8-12% time, which pushes the recipe under 0.753. Width 512 saves about 5-7% of time at about 0.2-0.3pp. CUDA graphs would cut launch overhead only if the run is CPU-bound, which I doubt. I expect 0-4% gain at most.

Unsure: the true 40-seed mean; whether the run is launch-bound; whether the 20 px phase hurts non-linearly.

forecasts.reason: Pixel savings give about 8% time at 9 epochs vs E007's 7.33s, but the 20px phase likely costs 0.4-0.6pp, putting accuracy at the 0.753 bar.
Relative to E007 (7.33s, 0.759), narrowing saves about 4-6% time and likely costs 0.1-0.3pp, within noise.
Diagnostic with no recipe change. Held-out seeds likely land slightly below the seeds 0-2 mean, with per-seed std about 0.25pp.
CUDA graphs help only if launch-bound. Expect a small gain (0-5%) at 9 epochs vs E007's 7.33s, and integration risk (Muon, EMA, lr tensors) may erase it.

cruxes: Is the run launch/CPU-bound or GPU-compute-bound? That decides whether CUDA graphs (I014) give about 0% or about 10%.
What are the true 40-seed mean and per-seed std? They decide how much accuracy margin remains for a 20 px phase or width cuts.
Does the accuracy cost of the 20 px phase stay near-linear? A cost over about 0.5pp sinks I011.
